question: Will Kylian Mbappé record the most goal contributions at the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
rules:
This market will resolve to the player who records the most goal contributions combined through all rounds of the 2026 FIFA World Cup competition.

For the purpose of this market, a goal contribution is defined exclusively as the number of combined goals and assists a player has recorded.

In the event of a tie, this market will resolve according to the official leader as determined by FIFA World Cup rules. If multiple leaders are announced then this market will resolve to the player who scored more goals during the 2026 FIFA World Cup. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the player whose listed last name comes first alphabetically.

If the 2026 FIFA World Cup competition is cancelled, postponed after August 2, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or there is otherwise no official leader declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from FIFA; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

evidence.excerpt: Mbappé recorded his seventh goal of the tournament, putting him ahead of Argentina's Lionel Messi in the Golden Boot race thanks to his two assists.

Kylian Mbappe scored his seventh goal of the FIFA World Cup 2026 as France overcame Paraguay to set up a quarter-final meeting with Morocco. Mbappe struck a second-half penalty to settle an attritional contest at Philadelphia Stadium, moving level with Lionel Messi on goals but leading on assists in the race for the 2026 adidas Golden Boot.

Argentina avoided a huge World Cup upset as they eventually overcame a stubborn Cabo Verde side to reach the last 16. Messi scored his seventh goal of the tournament. With Egypt in their sights, Nicolas Tagliafico said that Argentina had progressed without producing the performance they wanted.

Erling Haaland struck two late goals as Norway stunned record five-times champions Brazil 2-1 in the World Cup last 16 on Sunday to send the Scandinavian team into the quarter-finals for the first time. Haaland pulled level with Kylian Mbappe and Lionel Messi in the Golden Boot race with his seventh goal of the tournament.

evidence.excerpt: Michael Olise finished the match against Sweden with two assists and struck the post with an effort that would have been his first goal of the World Cup. He had played 308 minutes in the tournament and was its leading assist provider with five. Alongside Mbappé and Ousmane Dembélé, he was among the players to have started every match for France.

evidence.publisher: Yahoo Sports / Evening Standard — Matt Verri
evidence.excerpt: Mbappé finished the 2022 tournament with eight goals and two assists. Messi finished with seven goals and three assists.

With eight goals in seven appearances, Mbappe produced the highest-scoring World Cup by any individual player since Ronaldo's identical haul in 2002. He became the first player to score a World Cup final hat-trick since Geoff Hurst in 1966. France finished as runners-up and Mbappe won the adidas Golden Boot.
